affectlens.training_split: Original FER2013 Training, plus 0.15 interpolation toward seven-class FER+ votes on training rows only, and ImageNet initialization
affectlens.model_selection_split: FER2013 PublicTest, macro-F1 early stopping; optional logit temperature calibration on PublicTest
affectlens.transform: 48x48 grayscale cropped face, CLAHE clipLimit 2.0 tileGridSize 4x4, OpenCV cubic resize to 96x96, scale to [0,1], subtract 0.449 and divide by 0.226. Native and horizontally reflected views run through the same pipeline; cache logits are their arithmetic mean.
affectlens.license: Model weights CC BY-NC 4.0 for non-commercial research/education/demo, subject to underlying FER2013/FER+ terms. Source MIT.

oxford_alexnet.training_split: FER2013 Training and VGG-Faces pretraining, as documented in the publisher checkpoint table
oxford_alexnet.model_selection_split: Publisher benchmark defines PublicTest as validation. Historical checkpoint-selection procedure has not been independently established.
oxford_alexnet.publisher_reporting_split: PublicTest validation and PrivateTest test with original FER2013 labels
oxford_alexnet.transform: 48x48 grayscale cropped face, PIL bilinear resize to 227x227, replicate grayscale into three RGB channels, preserve [0,255] scale and subtract [131.09375, 103.88607788085938, 91.47599792480469]. Single original view. Conv and BatchNorm fused in eval; no change to the intended model function.
oxford_alexnet.license: Publisher makes checkpoints and architecture source publicly downloadable. No explicit redistribution license was located for this PyTorch checkpoint. Reference downloads rather than bundling weights.

prediction_scope: Both cache builders read images, source row IDs and exact pixel hashes only. They never open PrivateTest labels. The two architectures emit seven classes as ordered above.
